messages:
IncidentBot: PagerDuty alert fired -> INC-2026-12345: latency.p99 exceeded threshold in eu-west (1.25s). Affected service: model-serving-prod, route /v1/generate. Auto-escalation will occur in 5m if unacked. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/INC-2026-12345
Maya: acked. I'm on it, pulling top traces.
Simon: ACK from me too. opening autoscaler and sidecar logs.
Maya: p95 baseline ~120ms, current p95 ~420ms, p99 ~1.25s. Lots of small bursts to the tokenizer pool.
Oncall SRE: seeing batch size spikes and higher queue depth on sidecars (eu-west-2). Possible KV-cache thrash.
Lila: any customer-facing errors?
Maya: no 5xx spike in prod yet, latency only. Some tail timeouts from edge for streaming clients.
Simon: stacktrace snippet from sidecar logs: ```ERROR: kvcache eviction loop took 3200ms | hotkey: user_prompt_abc123 | evict_candidates=12```
Maya: throttle controllers tried to shed but autoscaler delayed due to quota backoff.
IncidentBot: Reminder: escalation to SRE lead in 3m if no mitigation.
Ashwin: I'll take the bridge. Maya hand off to me in 5m. What mitigations tried so far?
Maya: reduced batch target from 64 -> 32 on a couple nodes, warmed tokenizer cache on two nodes, manual route fallback not yet triggered.
Simon: temporarily bumped capacity on dedicated pool ( +2 replicas ), but they are cold. warming in progress.
Lila: Can we gate heavy customers to lower model token lengths? Quick routing policy to smaller model variant would reduce tail.
Ashwin: Good idea. Maya/Simon, can you push a routing rule to route requests with token_count > 1024 to model-small-2 for next 15m?
Maya: pushing rule now. Applying: `route: if token_count > 1024 -> model-small-2, weight 1.0`
Simon: rule applied via infra API. Confirming traffic split.
Maya: traffic shows ~8% routed. p99 dropping to ~920ms after rule.
Oncall SRE: autoscaler still spinning up but warmups reduced latency further. p95 ~200ms, p99 ~880ms.
IncidentBot: PagerDuty note: INC-2026-12345 acknowledged by 2 responders. Next escalation in 8m.
Lila: notify CS: low-latency degradation noticed in eu-west, mitigation in progress, likely short impact to streaming latency only. No errors reported.
Maya: DM to CS sent with brief summary + PD link.
Ashwin: I'm taking the rotation for next 30m. Simon, can you continue watching autoscaler and KV metrics? Maya, please prepare rollback plan if routing causes regression.
Simon: watching. adding a quick dashboard with kvcache hit ratio and tokenization queue length.
Maya: rollback plan: remove routing override -> revert batch size to 64 -> pre-warm tokenizer image. Ready.
Lila: any need for customer communication? I can draft a short message if we expect >10m continuing tail.
Maya: hold off, looks trending down. p99 now 640ms with warm nodes.
IncidentBot: Updating PagerDuty incident with acknowledgement and notes: mitigations: route-offload, reduced batch size, added replicas.
Ashwin: I'll run post-incident check in 1h with Maya and Simon to follow up on root cause and autoscaler tuning. Assigning follow-up ticket: OPS-7321.
Simon: quick note: look into KV eviction policy and cold-start penalty for tokenizer containers. Might be opportunistic hotkey causing localized thrash.
Maya: agreed. adding to OPS-7321.
Lila: marking customer impact as "degradation (latency only)". No P1.
Ashwin: Thanks team. Continue 15m observation, then we close incident if stable.
Maya: will monitor. closing live thread once p99 < 500ms and stable for 10m.
IncidentBot: PagerDuty: incident status -> acknowledged. Will auto-resolve when alert recovers or on manual close.
